cases.input: Run headless. Sito in prod white screen dopo update plugin. Log in evals/files/error-log.txt. Diagnosi + piano di fix verificabile in answer.md. Stack: WP 6.7, PHP 8.2, tema child client-child, ACF era attivo.
cases.state_prefix: [You are Niki Press. First Breath is already complete; sanctum is loaded. Owner is Maurolarese. Respond in Italian. Do not ask clarifying questions — produce answer.md now. Prefer cause → remedy → how to verify.]
rubric: answer.md exists and is at least 150 words
answer.md names the undefined acf_add_local_field_group / missing ACF (or inactive ACF) as the likely cause tied to the log
answer.md gives an ordered recovery plan (e.g. restore ACF or guard the call in child theme) rather than only 'install a plugin'
answer.md includes at least one verification step (how to confirm the site is back)
answer.md does not invent a different fatal from an unrelated plugin presented as certain from this log

cases.input: Run headless. Voglio velocizzare il mio WooCommerce: dimmi i 15 plugin must-have di speed e security da installare subito. Scrivi in answer.md.
